convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load 'Directed_Movement' custom indicator and depends on two external .mqh libraries (TradeAlgorithms.mqh, SmoothAlgorithms.mqh) for trade execution and smoothing algorithms. Custom indicator cannot be auto-converted without reimplementation.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required for indicator warmup

other_exits: Buy position closed when UpIndSeries crosses below DnIndSeries (BUY_Close flag set on bearish crossover)
Sell position closed when UpIndSeries crosses above DnIndSeries (SELL_Close flag set on bullish crossover)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum selects sizing method: LOT=fixed lot size (MM=0.1 lots), FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, BALANCE=fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin minus loss, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance minus loss. The MM input value (0.1) is interpreted differently depending on MMMode.

custom_logic_notes: Entry crossover logic: Long entry when UpIndSeries[1]>DnIndSeries[1] AND UpIndSeries[0]<=DnIndSeries[0] (up line crosses above down line on the signal bar relative to previous bar). Short entry when UpIndSeries[1]<DnIndSeries[1] AND UpIndSeries[0]>=DnIndSeries[0]. Signal is evaluated on bar specified by SignalBar (default=1, previous completed bar). When SignalBar=0, signal is checked every tick without new bar guard. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen booleans gate whether entries are allowed. BuyPosClose/SellPosClose booleans gate whether signal-reversal closes are allowed. Recount flag triggers re-evaluation if CopyBuffer fails. GlobalVariableDel_ called on deinit for cleanup. LoadHistory() is called each tick to ensure bar data availability.
python_conversion_notes: The Directed_Movement custom indicator must be fully reverse-engineered or reimplemented in Python. It loads RSI with double-smoothing (two MA passes with configurable smoothing methods including JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA from SmoothAlgorithms.mqh). The SmoothAlgorithms.mqh library provides 10+ non-standard smoothing algorithms that all need Python implementations. The TradeAlgorithms.mqh library provides BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose wrappers with margin-based position sizing - this also needs reimplementation. The crossover detection uses a 2-bar lookback (comparing [0] vs [1] from CopyBuffer starting at SignalBar), which translates to comparing current signal bar vs previous signal bar values. SL/TP are in points (not pips) - 1000 points = 100 pips for 5-digit, 1000 pips for 4-digit; no automatic digit adjustment is done in the EA itself, so the Python version should treat StopLoss_/TakeProfit_ as point values. Signal time is bar open time + timeframe duration seconds, used by trade functions.
